# Draft exception list for bin/lint-node-id-format.sh (trunk linter: node-id-format).
#
# Format:  <path>[:<line>]   <reason>
#   - "<path>"          exempts the whole file
#   - "<path>:<line>"   exempts one call site
#   - blank lines and # comments are ignored; the reason column is mandatory
#
# These are pre-existing call sites captured when the linter landed, so the rule could
# start green without a 22-site cleanup in an unrelated PR. They are a backlog, not a
# blessing - the convention still applies. Line-scoped rather than file-scoped on
# purpose: a new bad call site in these files is still flagged, and an entry that rots
# as lines move just surfaces the site again, which is the nudge we want.
#
# The rule is warning-level, so nothing here blocks a merge either way.
